# Nullable embedding vectors and degraded search behavior

Embedding rows can have a null vector while pending backfill; the code notes search degrades to full-text search in that case. Pending/null vectors introduce varying search semantics and may complicate queries that assume vectors are present.

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.EmbeddingRow`
